children: The number of oil and gas rigs actively drilling in the U.S. rose by 4 to 595, Baker Hughes reported Friday in its latest weekly survey.

The number of active drilling rigs targeting crude oil in the U.S. gained rose by 2 to 452 in the week ended September 18, while gas rigs gained 2 to 134 and miscellaneous rigs remained unchanged at 9.

The total rig count was up by 53, or 9.8%, compared to the same time last year, while the number of rigs drilling for oil rose by 34, or 8.1%, from a year ago, and gas rigs gained 16, or 13.5%, from a year earlier.
Rigs targeting oil in the Permian Basin added 1 to 268 during the past week, while the Eagle Ford count stayed flat at 42 and the Williston Basin gained 1 to 30.

title: U.S. drilling rig count jumps by 4 in latest Baker Hughes survey
